conditions.rationale: Blank lanes: unstimulated wells, no ligand — S = 0, so the model predicts no phosphorylation and the subtracted blank rows read ~0.

Relative dose enters as the condition-owned constant S. No pre-equilibration: the description states the t=0 samples are unstimulated cells taken immediately before ligand addition, so the model's declared initial state (R=10, Rp=0) is the experimental starting state and simulating to steady state first would replace it with a phosphatase-dominated resting level the experiment did not have.
Reference dose; S=1 is the standard working stock against which the other two are expressed.
Highest dose. Held out for prediction per testcase.yaml — encoded here so the simulation is defined, but its measurements are excluded from the fit.
